name: Ubai Ending ~Hito no Onna, Saigo made Urimasu~
original_name: 奪 ENDING ～人の妻、最後まで売ります～
source:
Iijima Ryosuke, who continues to take women, is advised by Gen that his instincts will become dull if he only embraces women for work. It is true that the women who come to him are like carp on a chopping block, with no way out. 

Since he was aware of his sexual proclivities, he ransacked the women, thinking that he could approach them himself in private. He happens to be on good terms with Hiiragi Shizune, a married woman who catches his eye, but... 

At the same time, Ryosuke meets with Tsuyuguchi Keiji, one of the founders, who asks him if he would like to sleep with a certain married woman.

Ryosuke succeeds in having sexual relations with the wife, Fujishiro Kasumi, and even begins to have her as a client.

While having relations with both Kasumi and Shizune, Ryosuke begins to think more deeply about his future.

[From [url=https://www.ubai.org/ubai/ubai_ending/ubai_story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
继续追求女性的饭岛凉介被源建议，如果他只为了工作而拥抱女性，他的本能会变得迟钝。确实，来找他的女人就像砧板上的鲤鱼，没有出路。

由于他意识到自己的性倾向，他搜遍了这些女人，认为自己可以私下接近她们。他碰巧与吸引他目光的已婚妇女柊静音关系很好，但是…… 

与此同时，凉介会见了创始人之一露口敬司，后者问他是否愿意和某个已婚女人上床。

凉介成功地与妻子藤代霞发生了性关系，甚至开始把她当作客户。

在与霞和静音建立关系的同时，凉介开始更深入地思考自己的未来。

[摘自[url=https://www.ubai.org/ubai/ubai_ending/ubai_story.html]官方网站[/url]]
